scope: Verify live cross-repository propagation of the human-dignity computation boundary from Mapa through RafGitTools to public RafPolimata without making a human-value decision or deployment claim.
known_benefits: prevents computational output from being promoted to human-value authority
preserves explicit rights, child, privacy and uncertainty boundaries across repositories
known_harms: governance adds review and maintenance overhead
structural PASS could be misunderstood as certification if boundary text is ignored
distribution_of_benefit_and_harm: Immediate benefit is repository-level governance consistency; immediate burden is additional review. No direct end-user deployment is asserted.
privacy_data_surface: No personal data is required or intentionally processed by this readback case.
child_impact: No child-specific deployment is performed. Best interest remains a hard constraint; specialist review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
health_impact: No clinical recommendation is produced; clinical/domain review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
education_impact: No educational placement or learner decision is produced; domain review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
culture_and_belief_impact: The consumer boundary does not authorize computation to determine human worth or cultural truth.
environmental_impact: No material environmental measurement is established by this repository readback; review remains TOKEN_VAZIO when applicable.
consequence_radius: repository governance and research-artifact interpretation only; no direct production decision about an individual is authorized
reversibility_or_mitigation: Changes are version-controlled and PR-scoped; rollback is available by reverting relevant commits. External deployment remains separately gated.
appeal_path: Repository issue/PR review and human governance review; independent appeal authority remains TOKEN_VAZIO until established for a deployment context.
falsifier: Fail if any exact revision is unreadable, if Mapa permits autonomous human-value authority or self-promotion, if the local transport contract loses required invariants, or if RafPolimata lacks the declared human-dignity/rights/child/unknown-risk boundaries.
